name: prefix
label: Folder
help: The folder to list, for example `invoices/2026/`. Leave it empty for the root of the bucket.

name: sort
label: Sort by
help: Folders always come first. Encrypted items follow the plain ones of their group.

name: order
label: Order
help: Leave it empty to sort names from A to Z and dates from newest to oldest.

name: includeHidden
label: Include hidden items
help: Also list items hidden in Nubbo.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: The maximum number of results to be worked with during one execution cycle.
